title: Looking for game developer investor
author: HeadLow5768
selftext:
Basically I made this game as an Easter egg for my website. cbbp.link/cybercity

It is a text based cyber punk browser/mobile mmo

I'm working on a sequel (or whatever the name cybercity can be reworked because its pretty generic.)  But basically I want to make a bigger version (9x12 instead of 3x4) with art for all the locations/sub locations/robots etc

So play my game, if you think the game is interesting then let me know and we can partener up.

This game was made with gen ai, I came up with the stratagy ai did the text and the coding.

the new game im hoping all the art and text will be done by humans. I can probably do all the writing and I could probably 3d model the robots and scenes to make the art.
